newsitem.title: GERMANY: Air Dolomiti ups Lufthansa code-share load.
newsitem.headline: Air Dolomiti ups Lufthansa code-share load.

text.p: Italian regional airline Air Dolomiti said it has expanded seat capacity from Italy to Germany by 25 percent under its summer timetable effective March 30.
The private airline said it would operate 93 weekly code-share feeder flights from six Italian cities into the Deutsche Lufthansa AG Munich hub, a statement issued here said.
Air Dolomiti, a "Partner of Lufthansa" since 1994, has launched three daily flights between Pisa and Munich, with single Saturday and twice-daily Sunday services.
It has also added a third daily service from Munich to Verona.
Air Dolomiti said its Germany turnover grew 21.8 percent and passenger numbers rose 28 percent in 1996 but did not release any absolute figures.
Some 70 percent of the airline's Munich traffic was transit passengers transferring to other flights, mostly Lufthansa services, it added.
